  • Issue investigation,
  • Software maintenance,
  • Documentation,
  • Other duties as assigned


Required Skills

  • Experience in working in an n-tier web development environment
  • Working knowledge of SQL and database design
  • Excellent communication, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Must be able to work effectively individually and as part of a team


Desirable Skills

Experience in any other OO-based development environments (C++, C#, Java etc.)

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Community Manager
description:
Você vive futebol no dia a dia, acompanha tendências, transforma lances em conversa e sabe como criar interação real nas redes sociais? O Jogo a Jogo procura um(a) Community Manager para cuidar da relação com a nossa comunidade.


Falamos de esportes e apostas com uma linguagem leve, criativa e próxima do público brasileiro, sem abrir mão de informação, contexto e responsabilidade editorial. Procuramos alguém que saiba equilibrar resenha, timing e leitura de comunidade.


Devido à natureza do calendário esportivo, e em particular para a cobertura da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, é desejável flexibilidade de horário para cobrir online os jogos que serão transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, gosta de futebol para além do placar e entende o valor de construir comunidade — queremos conhecer você.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e publicar conteúdos diários para Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok e outras redes;
  • Monitorar menções e interagir com o público de forma criativa e respeitosa;
  • Estar atento(a) a trends, memes e momentos do futebol para gerar engajamento;
  • Colaborar com o time editorial para alinhar prognósticos, posts e campanhas;
  • Criar e redigir e-mails de marketing para a base de usuários do Apostas no IG ou em conjunto com os outros projetos e sites do grupo.
  • Acompanhar métricas e propor novas estratégias para aumentar o alcance.
  • Realizar a cobertura online da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, incluindo interações e posts em tempo real sobre os jogos transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia com social media ou community management;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas gráficas (Adobe photoshop,Illustrator etc) e edição de vídeo (Capcut,Riverside, After Effects etc);
  • Fluência em português brasileiro (conteúdo voltado para o público do Brasil);
  • Paixão por esportes, especialmente futebol;
  • Escrita criativa e ágil, com domínio de linguagem digital;
  • Organização para lidar com demandas rápidas e calendário editorial;
  • Noções de métricas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de redes sociais e CRM (Hubspot, RD Station, Optimove etc);
  • Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário para cobrir eventos e jogos online, em especial durante a Copa do Mundo.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência na gestão de perfis de humor ou entretenimento esportivo;
  • Habilidade para criar memes, reels ou vídeos curtos;
  • Conhecimento de SEO e tendências do universo esportivo online.


Local de Trabalho

Híbrido para quem morar em Porto, Portugal. Remoto para demais localidades.


Modelo de Contratação

Contratação Pessoa Jurídica / MEI


Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se pelo botão do LinkedIn.

Se tiver dúvidas e/ou quiser enviar portfólio adicional, escreva para:

Falamos de esportes e apostas com uma linguagem leve, criativa e próxima do público brasileiro, sem abrir mão de informação, contexto e responsabilidade editorial. Procuramos alguém que saiba equilibrar resenha, timing e leitura de comunidade.


Devido à natureza do calendário esportivo, e em particular para a cobertura da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, é desejável flexibilidade de horário para cobrir online os jogos que serão transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, gosta de futebol para além do placar e entende o valor de construir comunidade — queremos conhecer você.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e publicar conteúdos diários para Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok e outras redes;
  • Monitorar menções e interagir com o público de forma criativa e respeitosa;
  • Estar atento(a) a trends, memes e momentos do futebol para gerar engajamento;
  • Colaborar com o time editorial para alinhar prognósticos, posts e campanhas;
  • Criar e redigir e-mails de marketing para a base de usuários do Apostas no IG ou em conjunto com os outros projetos e sites do grupo.
  • Acompanhar métricas e propor novas estratégias para aumentar o alcance.
  • Realizar a cobertura online da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, incluindo interações e posts em tempo real sobre os jogos transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia com social media ou community management;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas gráficas (Adobe photoshop,Illustrator etc) e edição de vídeo (Capcut,Riverside, After Effects etc);
  • Fluência em português brasileiro (conteúdo voltado para o público do Brasil);
  • Paixão por esportes, especialmente futebol;
  • Escrita criativa e ágil, com domínio de linguagem digital;
  • Organização para lidar com demandas rápidas e calendário editorial;
  • Noções de métricas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de redes sociais e CRM (Hubspot, RD Station, Optimove etc);
  • Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário para cobrir eventos e jogos online, em especial durante a Copa do Mundo.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência na gestão de perfis de humor ou entretenimento esportivo;
  • Habilidade para criar memes, reels ou vídeos curtos;
  • Conhecimento de SEO e tendências do universo esportivo online.


Local de Trabalho

Híbrido para quem morar em Porto, Portugal. Remoto para demais localidades.


Modelo de Contratação

Contratação Pessoa Jurídica / MEI


Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se pelo botão do LinkedIn.

Se tiver dúvidas e/ou quiser enviar portfólio adicional, escreva para:

title: Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer
description:
Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As the Tech Lead for our JavaScript/TypeScript full‑stack team, you will guide technical direction, drive architectural decisions, and serve as a key technical counterpart to our client stakeholders. You’ll be a great contributor to the code quality and security aspects, while actively coaching engineers to deepen the team’s expertise in our core stack. You’ll be hands-on and equally strong in communication—facilitating technical discussions, translating business needs into technical plans, and ensuring we commit secure, scalable, and high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • As a technical lead, be a reference when communicating with the team and stakeholders (including the client);
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Help define and document practices, methodologies and processes relevant to technical teams, improving Encora’s knowledge base;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Mentor less experienced team members.

Essential Skills


  • Broad experience with full stack development based in JavaScript;
  • Experience with analysis, design, and implementation;
  • Experience NextJS and NodeJS;
  • Cloud knowledge (specially AWS Lambda, AWS CDK and serverless).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Knowledge about agile software development;
  • Experience in driving Scrum rituals (Planning, Daily, Review and Retrospective).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior


Local: Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)


Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior para atuar na mina subterrânea , sendo responsável pelo planejamento estratégico e gestão do sistema de ventilação , bem como pelo acompanhamento de sua execução junto à equipe de Infraestrutura, assegurando condições adequadas de qualidade do ar, segurança operacional, conformidade legal e suporte eficiente às atividades de lavra e desenvolvimento da mina.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;
  • Desenvolver e revisar projetos de ventilação para mina subterrânea (primária e secundária);
  • Realizar estudos de fluxo de ar, controle de gases, poeiras, temperatura e umidade;
  • Dimensionar ventiladores principais e auxiliares, dutos, portas e reguladores de ventilação;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os planos de ventilação da mina;
  • Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;
  • Liderar estudos avançados de ventilação e projetos associados à expansão, aprofundamento ou mudanças de layout da mina, viabilizando tecnicamente novos cenários operacionais com segurança e eficiência.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em ventilação de minas subterrâneas;
  • Vivência com softwares de ventilação (ex.: Ventsim, VentSim Design, VUMA ou similares);
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).


Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Principal .net Developer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver multiple new services for a new front office solution for top tier hedge fund. You'll have all the decision power to influence the architecture decisions and delivery process.


Primary Stack: .Net, Angular, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support the end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

- Fluent English and superb communication skills

- Expertise in computer science, algorithms, data structures, OOD and Design Patterns

- Expertise in C#/.Net backend development

- Hands on with distributed and high performance systems architecture

- Experience with databases, data modelling and scaling

- A collaborative and engaging personality, being a joy to work with, and contributing positively to our team culture.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Expertise in modern complex frontends in Angular

- Experience with Ag Grid, Glue42

- Experience with Azure

- Experience with investment finance


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.


You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.


You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Junior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks / Python / Spark
description:
Role: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term (Through Dec 2026)

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: 8am - 5pm CST

Location : 100% Remote


We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer with experience in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. The role involves developing ETL/ELT pipelines, optimizing data processing, and supporting cloud-based data platforms in an Azure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory
  • Build and optimize Apache Spark jobs for large-scale data processing
  • Work with Python and SQL to transform and analyze data
  • Support data architecture using Delta Lake and Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Collaborate with product owners and analytics teams to deliver reliable data solutions

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of Data Engineering experience
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong Python and SQL skills
  • Experience building ETL pipelines
  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory and cloud data platforms

Nice to have: Azure certifications, streaming data experience, or infrastructure-as-code knowledge.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.


About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.


Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.


Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.


Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits


  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Desenvolvedor PHP Pleno
description:
Oportunidade 100% Remoto e PJ


Estamos buscando desenvolvedores(as) de sistemas/aplicações Web, para colaborar na construção de aplicativos seguros, escaláveis e de alto desempenho. O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;

  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas.
  • Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores.
  • Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;

  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;
  • Experiência avançada com PHP;
  • Experiência com frameworks de mercado (Laravel, Zend ou Symfony);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, JavaScript, ReactJS;
  • Experiência na aplicação de arquitetura para projetos PHP e \"design patterns\";
  • Experiência avançada em base de dados (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL e MongoDB);
  • Experiência com Github
  • Experiência com as seguintes aplicações KeyCloak, RabittMQ Docker, DBEaver, MailHog, entre outras
  • Experiência ambientes Linux / Apache
  • OOP, Web Services, APIs Restfull, XML, SOA;
  • Sistema de Filas/Mensagerias (RabbitMQ);
  • Serviços em Nuvem AWS, GCP e Azure;
  • Experiência com qualidade de codificação e boas práticas tais como: testes unitários.
  • Conhecimento/participação de processos ágeis de desenvolvimento com experiência em metodologia ágil Scrum, XP, Agile.
  • Protagonismo (autodidata, assumir desafios, engajado) e capacidade de trabalho em equipes auto gerenciáveis.
  • Uso de assistentes de IA para codificação (ex: SuperMaven, Copilot, Gemini, OpenIA, Vercel AI, Lhama, Claude);

Requisitos e qualificações:

Certificações nos ambientes, e tecnologias descritas anteriormente

  • Conhecimento de outras linguagens (Java, Python)
  • Certificações web, qualidade de código, metodologia ágeis, etc

title: PLM Architect
description:
About us :

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Responsibilities

  • You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • You will analyze customers’ business requirements and successfully implement solutions as part of a cross-functional team.
  • You will lead and/or participate in, assist with, or act as the facilitator in workshops/work sessions.
  • You will support the definition of client-specific solutions for PLM, including application and technical architecture.
  • You will help our customers realize value faster by optimizing OOTB solutions and redefining processes, as needed.
  • You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing.
  • You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support.
  • You will ensure quality through established software engineering methods and processes.
  • You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders.
  • You will manage commitments within a flexible work schedule.

Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Strong PLM domain knowledge
  • Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Knowledge of PTC Windchill Product suites desired.
  • Be able to work autonomously and focus on goals.
  • Be customer service oriented.
  • Have programming skills, preferably in Java.
  • A desire to continue your professional growth through formal and on-the-job ongoing product and consulting skills training.

Must Have Skills

  • 5-10+ years’ experience in PLM, preferably PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • Participated in PLM Implementation projects.
  • Educational background in Engineering or Computer Science (bachelor’s or master’s Degree Level)
  • Languages: Advanced or Fluent Proficiency level (written and spoken) in English and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel, as needed


ITC Infotech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. ITC infotech is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women

  • You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • You will analyze customers’ business requirements and successfully implement solutions as part of a cross-functional team.
  • You will lead and/or participate in, assist with, or act as the facilitator in workshops/work sessions.
  • You will support the definition of client-specific solutions for PLM, including application and technical architecture.
  • You will help our customers realize value faster by optimizing OOTB solutions and redefining processes, as needed.
  • You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing.
  • You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support.

  • You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders.

  • Strong PLM domain knowledge
  • Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills

title: Coordenador(a) de Performance & Business Analytics Burger King
description:

Como será o seu desafio?


  • Traduzir grande volume de dados operacionais em insights claros e direcionamentos estratégicos para o negócio.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

  • Experience in ADAS/AV V&V, testing, and simulation.
  • Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
  • Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
  • Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
  • Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
  • Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the ‘e’ language, and/or SystemVerilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
  • MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) / Sales Representative to drive outbound sales and generate new business opportunities. The ideal candidate will be responsible for prospecting, outreach, and lead generation, helping expand our client base for software and engineering services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect potential clients through LinkedIn, email outreach, cold calling, and other outbound channels
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified leads
  • Conduct initial discovery calls to understand client needs
  • Schedule meetings and demos for senior sales or technical teams
  • Maintain CRM records and track outreach activities
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to improve outreach strategies
  • Research target industries and companies to identify potential opportunities
  • Achieve and exceed monthly lead generation and pipeline targets


Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in business development, sales, or lead generation
  • Experience in B2B outbound sales
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Experience using CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
  • Ability to manage high-volume outreach campaigns
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills

We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Desenvolvedor Front End Mobile

Conhecimentos obrigatórios: React Native - Avançado Android / Kotlin - Básico Objective-C / Swift - Básico Gitflow Metodologia ágil Scrum Restful (especificações de APIs e protocolos de comunicação)


Soft Skills: Comunicação eficaz: capacidade de se fazer entender de maneira clara e eficaz, sempre levando em consideração seu público-alvo. Saber ouvir atentamente e contextualizar o que é transmitido. Resiliência: entender como superar as adversidades do dia a dia e ser persistente até conseguir finalizar ou avançar em determinado processo. Iniciativa: capacidade de saber quando tomar uma atitude e ter iniciativa para agir. Colaboração: consciência de que o trabalho em equipe é fundamental para que as habilidades de cada um se complementem. Entender o produto: compreensão, mesmo que mínima, do produto, para conseguir uma solução que realmente se encaixe com os objetivos do Banco. Aceitar críticas: ter consciência de que uma crítica construtiva é uma ferramenta para melhoria, a fim de nos aperfeiçoarmos. Organização: administrar objetivos e prioridades para atingir um padrão de produtividade.


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Técnico Suporte ao Usuário
description:
Sobre nós


A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a Vaga:


Técnico de Suporte ao Usuário JR

Horário de trabalho: 15:40 a 01:10 - segunda à sexta-feira


Modalidade presencial em Itaúna, MG.


O profissional será responsável pelo suporte técnico de TI presencial na área de manufatura da Stellantis, atuando diretamente no atendimento aos usuários, bem como na montagem, manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de TI. A posição é dedicada à operação fabril, garantindo a disponibilidade, estabilidade e funcionamento adequado dos recursos tecnológicos utilizados na produção.


️ Responsabilidades

Atendimento presencial aos usuários da manufatura.

Montagem, configuração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva de desktops, notebooks e impressoras.

Instalação, formatação e atualização de sistemas operacionais.

Instalação e configuração de softwares corporativos.

Execução de backup e restauração de dados conforme procedimentos definidos.

Diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes relacionados a hardware e software.

Abertura, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados via ferramenta ITSM.

Apoio técnico em salas de produção e áreas administrativas da planta.

Suporte em atividades de troca, substituição e preparação de equipamentos (imaging, setup e testes).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência comprovada em suporte técnico de TI (hardware e software).

Vivência com montagem e manutenção de computadores e notebooks.

Experiência com impressoras (instalação, manutenção básica e troubleshooting).

Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows.

Experiência com atendimento ao usuário e uso de ferramenta de chamados (ITSM).

Boa comunicação, organização e senso de prioridade.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

Experiência em ambiente de manufatura ou indústria.

Vivência com backup e restore de dados.

Conhecimentos em redes básicas (TCP/IP, mapeamento de rede, impressoras em rede).

Cursando ou formado em TI ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimento em ferramentas como ServiceNow, SCCM, ou similares.

Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a Vaga:


Técnico de Suporte ao Usuário JR

Horário de trabalho: 15:40 a 01:10 - segunda à sexta-feira


Modalidade presencial em Itaúna, MG.


O profissional será responsável pelo suporte técnico de TI presencial na área de manufatura da Stellantis, atuando diretamente no atendimento aos usuários, bem como na montagem, manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de TI. A posição é dedicada à operação fabril, garantindo a disponibilidade, estabilidade e funcionamento adequado dos recursos tecnológicos utilizados na produção.


️ Responsabilidades

Atendimento presencial aos usuários da manufatura.

Montagem, configuração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva de desktops, notebooks e impressoras.

Instalação, formatação e atualização de sistemas operacionais.

Instalação e configuração de softwares corporativos.

Execução de backup e restauração de dados conforme procedimentos definidos.

Diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes relacionados a hardware e software.

Abertura, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados via ferramenta ITSM.

Apoio técnico em salas de produção e áreas administrativas da planta.

Suporte em atividades de troca, substituição e preparação de equipamentos (imaging, setup e testes).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência comprovada em suporte técnico de TI (hardware e software).

Vivência com montagem e manutenção de computadores e notebooks.

Experiência com impressoras (instalação, manutenção básica e troubleshooting).

Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows.

Experiência com atendimento ao usuário e uso de ferramenta de chamados (ITSM).

Boa comunicação, organização e senso de prioridade.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

Experiência em ambiente de manufatura ou indústria.

Vivência com backup e restore de dados.

Conhecimentos em redes básicas (TCP/IP, mapeamento de rede, impressoras em rede).

Cursando ou formado em TI ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimento em ferramentas como ServiceNow, SCCM, ou similares.

title: [Tech] Engenharia DevOps Sênior
description:
O especialista DevOps irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, e cresce a cada dia, ampliando continuamente seu potencial de impacto e inovação.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe.
  • Realizar atividade de triagem dos tickets abertos pelos clientes internos através da classificação ou categorização dos mesmos quando necessário, por tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento.
  • Promover ações de melhoria através da participação ativa das cerimônias do Ágil (Daily, reabastecimento, reviews e retrospectivas)
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/meta da área através da execução de suas atividades propostas
  • Identificar problemas de ambientes DevOps, integração contínua, e banco de dados implementando e inovando em soluções.
  • Estimular a equipe em processos de melhoria, usando seu conhecimento e experiência para identificar problemas e desenvolver soluções.
  • Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ambientes através da orientação dos demais integrantes do time no uso de boas práticas de DevOps.
  • Ser uma referência interna e externa em práticas DevOps, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos ambientes por meio da disseminação de conhecimento e participação de fóruns.
  • Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de mercado, com o objetivo de identificar e propor soluções que aprimorem a eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade dos ambientes e processos de desenvolvimento, integração e operação.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Metodologia Ágil – nível domínio;
  • Kubernetes – nível avançado;
  • Cloud Pública (AWS, Azure, GCP) – nível intermediário;
  • Azure DevOps – nível intermediário;
  • Linux, containers e ferramentas de automação – nível avançado;
  • CI/CD – nível avançado;
  • Arquitetura Cloud Native – nível intermediário.


Certificação:

  • CKA Certified Kubernetes Administrator – desejável;
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner – desejável;
  • AWS Sysops Administrator – desejável;

title: PI Developer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Insight Global is looking to hire a remote PI Developer working central hours. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior PI Developer to join our team working on an Oil and Gas compressor project. The successful candidate will assist in the development, implementation, and maintenance of PI systems to ensure efficient data collection, analysis, and reporting. This role is crucial for optimizing compressor performance and ensuring operational excellence.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 0-2 years of experience in PI system development or a related field.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in PI System software (PI Server, PI AF, PI Vision, etc.).
  • Basic understanding of data integration and ETL processes.
  • Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, SQL, or similar.

title: Analista de Relações com Investidores e ESG III
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Helbor Empreendimentos S.A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3 , a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.

A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
  • Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
  • Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
  • Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
  • Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
  • Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
  • Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
  • Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
  • Excel e PowerPoint em nível avançado;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.


Informações adicionais

O que nós oferecemos:


  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Participação nos Resultados
  • Wellhub
  • Zenklub
  • Espaço de descompressão equipado com vídeo games, ping pong e espaço para alimentação


Onde estamos: Faria Lima - SP

title: Analista de Relações com Investidores e ESG III
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Helbor Empreendimentos S.A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3 , a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.

A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
  • Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
  • Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
  • Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
  • Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
  • Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
  • Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
  • Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
  • Excel e PowerPoint em nível avançado;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.

title: DevOps Engineer (with Python)
description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with strong Python skills to support a team focused on improving customer operations through technology and data insights.

In this role, you will work closely with an external vendor building AI-assisted evaluation workflows that analyze customer interactions. Your primary focus will be on designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.

You will also contribute to backend services where needed, using Python to support data access, automation, and system integrations.


Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts , with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.

You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you’ll often act as the bridge between the vendor and internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.



What we’re looking for:


● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations)

● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)

● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)

● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling

● Good Python skills for scripting, automation, and backend support

● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders

● Strong communication and coordination skills



Nice to have:

● Familiarity with TypeScript or Node.js

● Exposure to AI-driven workflows or data platforms


This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working across development and infrastructure, enabling data-driven systems, and collaborating across teams to deliver impactful solutions.


Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.
